<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>evaluate-skill-change</code></p>

Measure a candidate skill against its baseline on repeatable routing and behavior cases before deciding on adoption.

## When to use

Measure whether a candidate skill improves routing and behavior over its baseline before adoption. Use only when explicitly requested and never install the candidate automatically.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link evaluate-skill-change --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Gate a proposed skill rewrite

**Prompt**

> Use the evaluate-skill-change skill with this baseline, candidate, and case file. Tell me whether the candidate should be adopted.

**Expected outcome**

An accept, reject, or needs-review decision based on identical cases, held-out coverage, validation, and regressions.

### Check a trigger change

**Prompt**

> Use the evaluate-skill-change skill to compare these skill descriptions for routing precision without installing either candidate.

**Expected outcome**

Comparable routing and behavior evidence with the live skill left untouched and no automatic adoption.
